info.title: Monid API
info.description: Agentic payment platform for data — agents discover and buy data on demand. Authenticated `/v1/*` routes accept a Monid API key or Clerk JWT as a Bearer token. All errors return `{ code, message }`. List endpoints use cursor pagination; consult each operation schema for its last-page cursor encoding.

Bearer.description: Monid API key (`Authorization: Bearer mk_...`) or Clerk-issued JWT.

AuthWorkspace.description: Absent when the caller is not part of a workspace.

code.description: HTTP status code, duplicated in the body.

slug.description: Organization slug from Clerk. `null` when the organization has no slug.

score.description: Final composed reranker score. Opaque sort context — not a fixed-range relevance probability.

scoreBreakdown.description: Per-signal breakdown of the reranker's final score (`querierScore` plus one raw log-odds shift per signal).

hints.description: Endpoint-authored workflow hints, polymorphic by client (rendered command string for cli/api/mcp; structured target for web). Omitted for unknown clients and endpoints without authored hints.

query.description: Natural-language search query for data endpoints.

limit.description: Requested result count. A config-driven server-side cap (`service.discover.max_results`) applies.

minScore.description: Per-call override for the post-rerank score floor. Results scoring below this are filtered out before truncation to `limit`. Falls back to the configured default when omitted.

displayName.description: Resolved endpoint display label. Always populated.

displayDescription.description: Resolved endpoint display blurb. May be empty.

tags.description: User-facing tags (e.g. `["verified"]`). Always an array; empty when no tags are set on the indexed wrapper.

notes.description: Operator-curated notes for agents — quirks, pitfalls, best practices.

hints.description: Agent guidance map (phrase → hint), polymorphic by client: rendered command string for cli/api/mcp, structured target for web. Omitted for unknown clients.

pathParams.description: JSON Schema for URL path parameters (e.g. /users/{id}).

queryParams.description: JSON Schema for query string parameters.

body.description: JSON Schema for the request body (POST/PUT/PATCH).

bodyType.description: Body content type (when body is present).

EndpointInput.description: Structured input — JSON Schema per param location (path, query, body).

error.description: Provider error body, passed through faithfully on failure.

metadata.description: Provider-specific debug metadata lifted from the raw response.

snapshot.description: Dollarized control state snapshot at gate time (same shape as /v1/runs/{runId}/controls).

input.description: Composite endpoint input — body + URL query + URL path. All sub-fields optional.

status.description: Run lifecycle status. COMPLETED means the provider responded (any HTTP status); FAILED means an infrastructure failure.

walletStatus.description: Wallet provisioning status (e.g. PROVISIONING, FAILED). Null when the wallet does not exist yet.

maxAmount.description: Maximum top-up amount in dollars. Omitted when no app-level cap is configured.

limitAmount.description: Budget cap for the window, in dollars.

spentAmount.description: Settled spend in the current window, in dollars.

heldAmount.description: Outstanding holds for in-flight runs, in dollars.

windowStart.description: ISO 8601 — which window the counters represent.

holdAmount.description: Estimated cost reserved at run start, in dollars.

settledAmount.description: Actual cost at settlement, in dollars. Null while HELD.

estimatedCost.description: Estimated cost at check time, in dollars.

lastUsedAt.description: Last time the key authenticated a request. Absent if never used.

count.description: Number of items on THIS page (not the total).

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; absent when no more pages.

total.description: Total endpoints matching the query, irrespective of pagination. Capped — see `totalIsCapped`.

totalIsCapped.description: `true` when `total` met or exceeded the count cap; the real count is unknown but >= `total`.

post.description: Start an execution of an endpoint. For a sync COMPLETED run the HTTP status FAITHFULLY MIRRORS the provider's own status (2xx → 2xx, provider 4xx/5xx → 4xx/5xx, request-timeout → 504); the body always carries the full run. A control gate returns a 200 BLOCKED run, and a run that exceeds its time budget returns 408 (TIMED_OUT). Async endpoints return a 202 acceptance ack — poll GET /v1/runs/{runId} for the result.

200.description: Terminal run — COMPLETED (sync execution, when the provider responded 2xx) or BLOCKED (a workspace control gate rejected the run). A COMPLETED run with a non-2xx provider status is returned with that same HTTP status and this body shape — EXCEPT a provider 402 (the upstream vendor's payment/quota failure, not your wallet), which is returned as 502.

202.description: Async run accepted — poll GET /v1/runs/{runId} for results

402.description: Payment required — workspace wallet balance insufficient. (A 402 from this API is ALWAYS about your wallet; an upstream provider's own 402 surfaces as 502.)

403.description: Forbidden — caller has no workspace or no access

408.description: TIMED_OUT — the run exceeded its time budget (run deadline or provider request timeout). Terminal, zero-billed; the body is the full run with status TIMED_OUT.

502.description: Upstream provider payment/quota failure — the provider returned 402 (its account problem, not your wallet). The body is the full COMPLETED run with the provider's error in providerResponse.error; the run is not charged.
